general_information.Description: "-Objective: The course is designed to provide students with essential skills and knowledge that enable English major students to conduct their translation and interpretation jobs after graduation. Upon completion of the course, students will obtain knowledge related to job ethics and skills needed to pursue careers as professional translators and/or interpreters. -Description: This course covers theoretical and practical knowledge related to translation and interpretation job. In addition to the ethic codes of the profession, the course guides students how to make necessary preparation for interpreting and/or translating projects related to literature, specialized documents, talk shows, conferences.... in an ethical way, how to deal with problems in translating and interpreting, how to communicate effectively in the profession. Besides, computer-aided and machine translation is also discussed in the course. -Teaching method: Constructive Teaching Method is highly recommended. Beside the lecture, students are required to accomplish some projects and take part in some professional talk shows where job-related stories are shared by experts.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes - Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Acquire theoretical general knowledge of professional translator ethics, ethic codes for translators and interpreters.
Acquire theoretical knowledge of professional translators and interpereters in different fields including literature, conflict and crisis, public services, child-language brokering.
Acquire theoretical knowledge of professional translators and interpereters in using technology in translation and interpretation.
Acquire theoretical and practical knowledge to start up in translation and intepretation
Acqurire skills & knowledge to conduct translation and interpretation jobs/projects in authentic environment
Be able to master and control some technologies in interpretation and translation
Be a responsible and ethical interpreter or translator

assessments.Question Type: Research Topic on Ethics in Translation and Interpretation
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: From unit 1- unit 8 CLO1 CLO2 CLO3 CLO7
assessments.Grading Guide: Students working in group of 3 doing research from Week 1 to Week 6. Time to finish reports: from sections 26-30

assessments.Question Type: Launch and Operate a Professional Translation and Interpretation Agency
assessments.Grading Guide: Each group of 3 students is assigned to seek a translation/ interpretation contact with customers to accomplish a job (translation or interpretation). Requirement: Over 14-15 page translation or 3-4 hour interpretation. Submission Requirement: approved translation product, recorded interpretation product, invoice or bank transfer. These must be email-confirmed by the customer)

assessments.Question Type: Students take part in Talk Show and make reports
assessments.Grading Guide: Students take part in Talk Show and make reports

Students work in group of 3 to write a proposal to set up a translation/interpretation business and present. Groups and topics are assigned by the class teacher in week 6 of the semester. Groups' written proposal and power must be submitted 2 days before the final day of week 10.
